items.t: Announced that no Department of Transportation federal funds would be provided to any cities that refuse to cooperate with federal immigration officials.
items.q: Secretary Sean Duffy announced that no federal funds from DOT would be provided to any cities that refuse to cooperate with federal immigration officials.

items.t: Was appointed by House Speaker John Boehner as a Republican member of the House select panel investigating Planned Parenthood.
items.q: former House Speaker John Boehner appointed the following eight Republican members of the select panel: chairman Rep. Marsha Blackburn, Rep. Joe Pitts, Rep. Diane Black, Rep. Larry Bucshon, Rep. Sean Duffy, Rep. Andy Harris, Rep. Vicky Hartzler, and Rep. Mia Love.

items.t: Warned the MTA in a letter requesting data on fare evasion and worker assaults that it could face consequences, up to and including redirecting or withholding funding, if it did not give prompt attention to the matter.
items.q: Duffy's letter requests the MTA's data on fare evasion, worker assaults, customer assaults and police patrols. It also requests an accounting of how the MTA has used federal funding to address safety and security in the city's transportation system. "I appreciate your prompt attention to this matter to avoid further consequences, up to and including redirecting or withholding funding," Duffy wrote.

items.t: Said "the data is going to guide" the FAA's decisions on flight reductions.
items.q: The data is going to guide what we do

items.t: Unveiled a package of actions in May to boost the air traffic controller workforce, including financial incentives and rewards for Academy graduates assigned to hard-to-staff facilities.
items.q: In May, Secretary Duffy unveiled a new package of actions to further supercharge the air traffic controller workforce, including financial incentives, rewarding Academy graduates who are assigned to hard-to-staff facilities

items.t: Said building a new air traffic control system "is an economic and national security necessity, and the time to fix it is now."
items.q: Building this new system is an economic and national security necessity, and the time to fix it is now

items.t: Said decades of neglect left the air traffic control system outdated.
items.q: Decades of neglect have left us with an outdated system that is showing its age

items.t: Said he would love a healthier snack on the airplane.
items.q: I would love a little healthier snack on the airplane," Duffy told Blaze News.

items.t: Said air traffic controllers "will be made whole quickly" after the government shutdown.
items.q: President Trump’s message has been heard loud and clear: controllers will be made whole quickly

record.t: Announced that the FAA is replacing floppy-disk-based systems in air traffic facilities with a new information display system (E-IDS).
record.q: replacing outdated floppy disks that contain vital weather and other critical information with a streamlined, 21st-century system

record.t: Announced FAA proposals for five rules to streamline commercial space launch and reentry licensing.
record.q: the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) is proposing five rules to streamline and modernize the commercial space launch and reentry regulations

record.t: Said he would order a 10% cut in flights at 40 major U.S. airports during the government shutdown.
record.q: U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said on Wednesday that he would order a 10% cut in flights at 40 major U.S. airports, citing air traffic control safety concerns as a government shutdown hit a record 36th day.

record.t: Announced, with FAA Administrator Bryan Bedford, an emergency order freezing flight reductions at 6% as air traffic controller staffing improved after the shutdown.
record.q: announced a new emergency order freezing flight reductions at the current six percent level

record.t: Was selected by President Trump on July 9 to serve as acting NASA administrator (2025).
record.q: On July 9, President Trump selected Sec. Duffy to serve as the acting NASA administrator.

record.t: Announced that the administration is terminating $4 billion in unspent federal funding for the California High Speed Rail Authority.
record.q: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy in July announced the administration is terminating $4 billion in unspent federal funding for the California High Speed Rail Authority (CHSRA)

record.t: Unveiled a plan to build a brand-new air traffic control system to replace the current one.
record.q: today unveiled a plan to build a brand new, state-of-the-art air traffic control system

record.t: Announced that the federal government has taken control of the renovations to Penn Station that were headed by New York City's transit authority.
record.q: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy announced Thursday that the federal government has taken control of the renovations to Penn Station that were headed by New York City’s transit authority.

record.t: Was confirmed by the Senate as Secretary of Transportation by a vote of 77-22.
record.q: Sean Duffy, of WI, to be Secretary of Transportation

record.t: Directed the FAA to restrict helicopter traffic over the Potomac River around Washington National Airport, stretching to the Wilson Bridge, days after the incident.
record.q: Days after the incident, the FAA, directed by Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy, restricted helicopter traffic in the area over the Potomac River around Washington National Airport and stretching to the Wilson Bridge.

record.t: Announced, with the FAA, that Peraton would be the prime integrator for building the new air traffic control system, backed by $12.5 billion from the One Big Beautiful Bill.
record.q: announced Peraton will be the Prime Integrator to lead the most important aviation infrastructure project in decades

record.t: Proposed a bill that would give President Trump new powers to raise tariffs in response to actions taken by other countries.
record.q: Wisconsin Republican Rep. Sean Duffy says his new bill would give President Trump new powers to raise tariffs in response to actions taken by other countries.

record.t: Introduced the Puerto Rico Oversight, Management and Economic Stability Act (PROMESA).
record.q: Representative Sean Duffy officially introduced the “Puerto Rico Oversight, Management and Economic Stability,” or PROMESA, which was largely drafted by, and will be marked up in, the House Committee on Natural Resources.
